title: Rotary Offset on the Tormach microARC 4: every level that cuts takes two laps of A, so the PathPilot post refuses it (A counts past the -360..360 travel)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found while writing the continuous 4-axis walkthrough for #1904 (stacked on PR #2342, which posts wrapped A on `tormach.cps`).

**What happens.** A Rotary Offset rough on the microARC 4 machine file does not post once a level meets the part:

```
post blocked - 1 warning(s): A361.862 in operation Journal is beyond the A axis travel -360..360 degrees - A counts on through 360 (PathPilot does not roll A over), so the operation turns too far in one direction
```

**Why.** `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_offset.rs` develops the bar as a cover of two laps plus the seam pad ("the cover is two laps, the seam copy included"); only an air level sweeps one lap. PathPilot does not roll A over (Hub reading 1 on #796), so the post counts A on, and the machine file states A travel -360..360 (kept in PR #2342: "PathPilot's real A limits are an open Hub check"). Two laps plus the pad cannot fit in 720 degrees.

**Repro (on the #1904 branch, before the demo was changed to Rotary Parallel).** 3/4 in round bar as stock (a model, R 0.375 in, X-1.5..0), a stepped model (journal R 0.340 in), 1/8 in ball, Rotary Offset with radial stepdown 0.03 in, any strategy (Auto, Zigzag, Waterline, Offset rings; climb or conventional): each is refused with A between 360.9 and 363.4. With a Box stock and a 0.1 in stepdown the only level is an air level (one lap, A-86.25..273.75) and it posts, but it cuts nothing.

**Expected.** One of:
- the rough's rings close without a second lap (or each ring unwinds: lift, turn A back, go on), so a level stays inside 720 degrees; or
- the machine file states the travel PathPilot really allows, if the Hub check of PR #2342 (step 5) shows it is wider; or
- the refusal says what to change.

**Workaround.** None found: Rotary Offset cannot be used on this machine file today. Rotary Parallel posts (its A stays inside one turn).

Done means: a Rotary Offset rough of a round bar posts on `tormach-770mx-microarc4.mch` with `tormach.cps`, pinned by a test, or the limit is documented with a refusal that names the fix.
